properties.name: The nodes of a line of reasoning are held in its project, and detect_gaps on an argument raises gaps that fit an argument, not a software build
properties.source: @ajs, 2026-10-18: "Capture the shortcomings (gaps) from the trial" (cogito trial; Arrow N21)
properties.statement:
Claims, steps, objections and replies written for a line of reasoning are contained in its project, or scope reaches them, so detect_gaps scoped to the project sees them. For a design whose domain is an argument or proof, detect_gaps does not raise a build's gaps (an artifact standard; a closure criterion over "live requirements") as if they applied.
Observed in the cogito trial (2026-10-18): the add_* tools take no project, so the project contained nothing. detect_gaps on it had region_size 1 and raised "what standard its design artifacts must be in" and a closure gap over "28 live requirements". The Arrow trial's N21 was the same.
